item.title: Apple News Continues Rejection of Right-Leaning Outlets in January
item.description: Apple News Continues Rejection of Right-Leaning Outlets in January Apple News continued its defiant stance against offering news from right-leaning outlets through the end of January 2026. Apple News stubbornly refrained from using any right-leaning outlets in the top 20 articles of its morning editions between Jan. 1 and Jan. 31, 2026.
